name: marker
title: Marker
description: Inline marker for annotations and status.

files.content:
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function Marker({ className = "", ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>) { return <span className={`co-inline-flex co-items-center co-rounded-sm co-bg-black co-px-1.5 co-py-0.5 co-text-xs co-font-medium co-text-white ${className}`.trim()} {...props} />; }

meta.accessibility: Uses semantic HTML, preserves keyboard operation, exposes visible focus, and keeps accessible naming under consumer control.
